notes: CM Manik Saha laid the foundation stone/bhoomi pujan for the Airtel data centre at Chanmari, Agartala (West Tripura) on 29 Jan 2026, billed as the largest data centre in India's Northeast. State allotted 1 acre of land (announced in Assembly Jan 2025), MoU signed Sep 2025; Airtel confirmed as eastern India's first Airtel DC. Capacity not disclosed; construction underway per foundation ceremony.
